name: Twin-Groove Seal
description: A rigid shoe links two contacts across separate engraved circular mazes. Each polar move changes the legal motion at both plates.
natural_language: Walk the linked red and blue contacts through both engraved groove plates, then release the brass shoe only when both exit channels are clear.

metadata.notes: Original procedural twin-plate implementation grounded in the Cast Laby polar controls: radial translation, angular translation, shoe rotation, two visible groove maps, collision-free contact replay, and a supplied simultaneous-exit predicate.
